name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you prove your devotion to the Holy Light through charity and protection for ordinary citizens. The Tome of Divinity tests your commitment to serve others.
As an Alliance defender, you are reminded that Stormwind's spiritual strength rests in safeguarding the vulnerable among your people.

faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a series of trials for aspiring paladins. Guided by mentors at Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, initiates show moral virtue, charity, and duty by helping citizens in need across the kingdom.
faq.q: What is the Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: Duthorian Rall is a senior paladin trainer at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. He guides fledgling paladins in their spiritual education and moral trials, judging whether their deeds uphold the virtues of the Holy Light.

The trial teaches that wielding the Light calls for humility, selfless sacrifice, and service to others. It prizes compassion, charity, and moral duty to the people of Azeroth alongside martial skill.
faq.q: What is the lesson behind this trial?

aliases: where does this quest take place
where to turn in tome of divinity
faq.answer: The trial centers on the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. Initiates go out to help the populace, then return to report their deeds to Duthorian Rall at the cathedral.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

aliases: who was helped in this quest
faq.answer: The trial brings aid to those in dire need, including young children. The recipient gives heartfelt thanks and reminds paladins in Stormwind never to turn away from the innocent and destitute.

aliases: why does charity matter to paladins
faq.answer: Duthorian Rall emphasizes charity because the Holy Light calls for generosity and the defense of the innocent. He teaches that a paladin must sacrifice for others and value their well-being above their own.
faq.q: Why does Duthorian Rall emphasize charity?

sections.body: Paladins in the service of the Holy Light face a defining trial in Stormwind City. At the Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall sends initiates to prove their devotion through moral conduct and selfless deeds for the kingdom's citizens. Martial glory alone will not suffice.
sections.title: A Trial of Virtue

sections.body: After aiding the vulnerable, initiates return to Duthorian Rall. They have brought needed relief to children and earned their heartfelt gratitude. Their mentor sees the value in putting others first. He teaches that charity, compassion, and duty to the people of Azeroth mark the path of the Light.
sections.title: The Virtue of Selflessness

summary: In Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Duthorian Rall guides paladins through a trial of devotion to the Holy Light. They prove their worth through charity, selflessness, and a duty to protect those in need.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
